outcome: An SSR render releases the effect scopes it created instead of leaking them across requests

acceptance_criteria.text: Rendering a component to a string leaves no effect scope attached to the SSR context afterwards.

expected_verification.assertion: the SSR context carries no live component scopes once renderToString resolves

acceptance_criteria.text: Watchers created during the render are stopped, and an error thrown while stopping one does not prevent the others from being stopped.

expected_verification.assertion: a throwing unwatch does not prevent the remaining watchers from being stopped

data_impact: None. Per-request in-memory state on the server.
security_impact: None directly. Leaked scopes across requests would be a cross-request state issue, which is what this intends to prevent.
